title.rendered: Air Quality Update for September 10, 2020 – Events Cancelled

content.rendered:
Due to rapidly worsening air quality conditions, all events happening today at our school locations, including drive-through events and supply pick-ups, are cancelled for the remainder of the day.  Families currently at the school locations will be served, however we ask that no additional families come to our school locations at this time. 

Please stay tuned for additional communications as we monitor ongoing conditions.
